combinations.magnitude: ZFP612 knockdown-induced hypersensitivity almost abolished in Il1rl1-/- mice
combinations.evidence_quote: More importantly, DRG ZFP612 downregulation-induced mechanical allodynia and heat hyperalgesia were almost abolished in Il1rl1−/− mice (Fig. 2p–r and Supplementary Fig. 5m, n).

combinations.magnitude: ZFP612 anti-nociceptive effect significantly impaired in silencer-/- mice
combinations.evidence_quote: Likewise, ZFP612-mediated anti-nociceptive effect, including mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in SNL, was also significantly impaired in silencer−/− mice (Fig. 3l–n).

combinations.readout: Il1rl1 TSS-1/2/3 transcripts, total Il1rl1 mRNA and IL1RL1 protein in injured DRG
combinations.magnitude: ZFP612 repressive effects absent in silencer-/- mice
combinations.evidence_quote: However, these repressive effects by ZFP612 were absent in silencer−/− mice (Fig. 3j, k).

combinations.magnitude: decoy DNA impaired ZFP612 anti-nociceptive effect on days 3 and 5 after SNL
combinations.evidence_quote: Behaviorally, DRG microinjection of decoy DNA impaired the ZFP612 anti-nociceptive effect on mechanical allodynia and heat hyperalgesia on days 3 and 5 after SNL (Supplementary Fig. 7c–e).
